notes.title: Welcome Scoreboard!
notes.content:
Hello Dear Followers! 

Slowly but confidently I keep making this piece of art playabale software, and today I want to tell you that I've added scoreboard, where you could see some information and features about other players, such as:

[list]
[*] Ping
[*] Name
[*] Steam Profile Pic
[*] Current height
[*] View steam profile button
[*] Kick from the lobby button
[/list]

Ofcourse it works only in multiplayer sessions, and if you don't want to play the game alone, join my discord server where you could find the ones who you could play with. 

See ya!
cloodhee

notes.title: Residents of the concrete chasm
notes.content:
The concrete voids evoke a sense of loneliness, yet you’re unlikely to be truly alone — beneath this sea of concrete, countless robots exist, most of whom, just like you, dream of reaching the surface.

But each of them is unique in their personality and behavior.

One thing is certain — they mean you no harm, so you can consider them your friends, though in truth, they are your brothers.

notes.title: The nature of Red Chambers
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001614/35c0315c8fd69daee3be3f09ed7ae0455684c6d9.png[/img]

Upon entering this room, you will realize that you cannot use your jet boost. That is its defining trait. But what is the reason behind it? What exactly is preventing you from using it?

Could it be the lack of an electrified floor? Or perhaps the presence of explosive gases in the air? Or maybe this is just another test, designed by the Mastermind to assess the robots' abilities and eliminate those who are unworthy?

notes.title: Welcome Vending Machines!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001614/6c2cdf1ba50f08bc9e2d8de230d32135b41b9755.png[/img]
A Long-Awaited Trading Mechanic Has Arrived! Now you can find vending machines scattered throughout levels, allowing players to exchange gears for various in-game items designed to attract the attention of robots.

[h1]What are Gears?[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45001614/82066b1858280351ed79a722678ba5c71f87e780.png[/img]

Gears are an in-game currency that players can find in hard-to-reach places or secret zones. Your robot friends may also reward you with gears when you lend them a helping hand.

[h1]What’s in Store?[/h1]

The items available in vending machines are perfect for attentive players wanting to delve deeper into the game world and for those simply looking to have fun. I’m excited to see how you’ll use these items to unleash your creativity!

And don’t worry: items in vending machines aren’t essential for completing the game. Feel free to ignore them entirely if you’d like!
